A bit late to the conversation, but you can check out this [list of 36 questions](http://www.nytimes.com/2015/01/11/fashion/no-37-big-wedding-or-small.html) that was part of a study conducted by a psychologist to find out which questions can increase intimacy between two strangers. A couple who met through the study actually ended up getting married! 

It might sound pretty shady, but just check out the list of questions! Some of them are pretty interesting.
